project_state.name: DraftReviewr
project_state.summary: Standards seed data, default seed loading/reset, review output language setting, single settings JSON export/import, and wider review result dialog.
project_state.runtime: Next.js 15.2.4 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4.

modules.name: seed-data
modules.public_surface: Nested document type seed JSON with review_items plus common review item seed JSON.

modules.name: seed-loader
modules.public_surface: initializeSeedDataIfEmpty() and resetToSeedData() load public/data seeds into draftreviewr:* localStorage keys.

modules.name: language-setting
modules.public_surface: Language is stored under draftreviewr:language with ko/en values and injected into all review prompts.

modules.name: settings-serializer
modules.public_surface: exportSettingsJson(), getSettingsExportFileName(), and importSettings(json) for version 1 settings JSON.

modules.name: review-result-width
modules.public_surface: Review result DialogContent uses sm:max-w-[112rem] for a wider result reading surface.

routes.integration: SeedInitializer is mounted globally; document review results open in the wider DocumentReviewDialog.
Default seed reset and settings export/import entry points.

export_import_format.shape: document_types[] with nested review_items[], common_review_items[], exported_at, and optional language on import
export_import_format.import_semantics: Full replacement after validation; no merge support.
